top_news.title: Implementation of New Criminal Laws (Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita)
top_news.summary: The landmark criminal justice reform laws replace the colonial-era Indian Penal Code (IPC), Code of Criminal Procedure (CrPC), and Indian Evidence Act to modernize the justice delivery system with zero FIR and electronic evidence provisions.
top_news.upsc_relevance: GS Paper II - Structure, Organization and Functioning of the Executive and the Judiciary

top_news.title: Expansion of India's Ramsar Sites Network
top_news.summary: India adds new wetlands to the Ramsar list of international importance, emphasizing conservation of ecologically fragile urban and peri-urban water bodies and biodiversity hotspots.
top_news.upsc_relevance: GS Paper III - Conservation, Environmental Pollution and Degradation

top_news.title: RBI Framework for Domestic Systemically Important Banks (D-SIBs)
top_news.summary: The Reserve Bank of India updates higher capital requirements for D-SIBs to safeguard financial stability and address the 'too big to fail' risks in India's banking sector.
top_news.upsc_relevance: GS Paper III - Indian Economy and Issues Relating to Planning, Mobilization of Resources

top_news.title: ISRO's Progress on Gaganyaan Crewed Spaceflight Mission
top_news.summary: ISRO successfully conducts critical qualification tests of the human-rated L110 Vikas Engine, marking a major milestone towards India's first human spaceflight mission.
top_news.upsc_relevance: GS Paper III - Awareness in the Fields of Space and Technology

top_news.title: Operationalization of the Chabahar Port Agreement
top_news.summary: India secures a long-term contract to operate the Shahid Beheshti terminal at Iran's Chabahar Port, strengthening trade connectivity to Central Asia bypassing Pakistan.
top_news.upsc_relevance: GS Paper II - India and its Neighborhood- Relations, Effect of Policies of Developed and Developing Countries
